summary: Ecolane's blog post recommends six transit industry blogs for staying current on transit trends and news, alongside Ecolane's own 'Thoughts on Transit' blog. Each entry gets a short description covering its focus, such as industry news and case studies, green transit, state-of-the-art technologies, sustainable transport policy, U.S. DOT policy updates, and daily commentary by Yonah Freemark. The post is a clipped web page; the navigation, sharing links and footer boilerplate were ignored.
one_line: Ecolane's February 2019 blog post lists six recommended transit industry blogs, including Mass Transit Magazine, METRO Magazine, and The Transport Politic.
key_facts: The blog post 'The 6 Most Interesting Transit Blogs Out There Today' was published by Ecolane on February 27, 2019.
The post is categorized under TRANSIT TRENDS and MAAS – MOBILITY AS A SERVICE.
Ecolane's 'Thoughts on Transit' blog focuses on perspective, opinion and strategy on the transit industry, scheduling and dispatch software technologies, and trends.
Mass Transit Magazine combines industry news, case studies, and blog posts on all areas of mass transit, laid out by category.
METRO Magazine serves the public and private passenger bus and rail transit, and motorcoach industry.
The Transit Wire focuses on state-of-the-art technologies used in the public transportation industry and serves properties, government agencies, researchers, consultants, and vendors.
The blog author of The Transit Wire has experience working for the Boston Transportation Department and specializes in consulting for transit policy and planning.
The Institute for Transportation and Development Policy (ITDP) is a global nonprofit working to make cities more livable, equitable, and sustainable.
ITDP aims to reduce carbon emissions, enhance social inclusion, and improve the quality of life for people in cities.
Human Transit is described as the official blog of the U.S. Department of Transportation.
The Transport Politic is updated daily by Yonah Freemark, who discusses transportation issues around the globe.
The Transport Politic has an active commenting community.
Ecolane describes itself as the industry-leading provider of intelligent web-based transit scheduling software.
Ecolane's related articles include 'Ecolane Launches X4MaaS, the Netflix for Transportation' and 'Paratransit Rates: The Complete Guide to Paratransit Fares'.
